cards.title: Robot-specific behavior
items: Hardware map: Inc/global_inc.h:107-115.
This profile is shown with ROBOT_TYPE set to INFANTRY_2023_SWERVE; other global options retained.
Yaw GM6020; pitch GM6020; drive 3508; Swerve kinematics.
CHASSIS_POWER_CONTROL=0: no active firmware power allocation loop.
CAN_PASS_REF_INFO=0: UART task selected, but REMOTE_TYPE=VT13 disables its referee FIFO unpacking.
Steer output requires ENABLE_STEER; hip geometry requires ENABLE_HIP and fHipEnabled. Disabled packets use 0xFF bytes.

cards.title: Control and feedback
items: FreeRTOS: INS is realtime; gimbal high; chassis above normal (Src/freertos.c:164-177).
Gimbal + launcher target 4 ms; chassis target 5 ms. Blocking CAN delays can affect elapsed loop timing.
Motor CAN RX updates feedback; chassis also reads INS attitude and gimbal encoder state (chassis_task.c:177-180).
Gimbal waits for required motors at startup; relevant offline motors cause zero output (gimbal_task.c:203-322).
Referee heat and shooter-enable state affect launcher behavior (CAN_receive.c:1680-1683; shoot.c:689-715).

cards.title: Retained global configuration
items: REMOTE_TYPE=VT13; CV_INTERFACE=1; DEBUG_CV=1; SUPERCAP_TYPE=MACRM; COMPETITION_TYPE=RMUL.
ENABLE_SHOOT_REDUNDANT_SWITCH=0 selects low normal friction speed; it is not a blanket launcher-disable switch.
Actuator output also depends on enable flags in CAN_receive.c:44-102.
Diagrams describe committed source paths, not measured robot behavior or verified builds of every profile.

cards.title: Supporting firmware
items: Detection monitors device health. Calibration reads/writes MCU flash (calibrate_task.c:423-477). RGB task is enabled.
VOFA is disabled in current globals. OLED, custom UI, USB, battery and servo task creation is commented out (Src/freertos.c:179-210).
